'''2024 Eighth Annual GEMPC''' was the Players Committee online match-play championship on GEMP, February–May 2024. [[Matthew Harrison-Trainor]] won the Final Confrontation.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/8th-annual-gempc-feb-may-2024/</ref><ref name="wrap">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/matthew-harrison-trainor-wins-second-career-gemp-match-play-championship/ Matthew Harrison-Trainor Wins Second Career GEMP Match Play Championship], starwarsccg.org (30 May 2024). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261024141150/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/matthew-harrison-trainor-wins-second-career-gemp-match-play-championship.html?copy=2 Internet Archive]</ref>

== Streamed matches and prizes ==
Participants received an alternate-image participation slip of Raddus, and the tournament bracket was revealed on 2 February 2024 by [[Dan Tartaglione]] and [[Anthony Howard]] on the PC Twitch channel.<ref name="slack-gempc24-open">Star Wars CCG Slack, #announcements, [[James Martin]] (solidsnck), 5 January 2024 (“Snag an awesome border busting Raddus AI just for playing”) and 2 February 2024 (“5 PM ET on ... find out who is playing whom in the GEMPC when Dan Tartaglione and Anthony 'Gemp Sherriff/batmouse' Howard reveals the GEMPC bracket!”).</ref> Selected streamed matches announced on Slack included:<ref name="slack-gempc24-matches">Star Wars CCG Slack, #announcements, [[Dan Tartaglione]] (DTartagOne) and [[James Martin]] (solidsnck), 29 February – 9 April 2024 (#1875–#1876, #1884, #1888, #1894).</ref>
* 29 February 2024: [[Scott Lingrell]] vs. [[Brian Fred]] (Game 1)
* 3 March 2024: [[Mike Pistone]] vs. [[Anthony Howard]]
* 15 March 2024: [[Brian Fred]] vs. [[Sam Tashima]] (Top 16)
* 26 March 2024: [[Joe Olson]] vs. [[Matthew Harrison-Trainor]] (Game 2)
* 9 April 2024: #2 [[Mike Kessling]] vs. #54 [[Logan Pietig]] (Top 4, Game 1)
